demetrius.title: Demetrius, Captor of Rhodes
demetrius.condition: Earn the siege capstone and successfully capture Rhodes in the alternate-history outcome.
demetrius.biography: In this alternate history, Demetrius captured Rhodes after a campaign of siegecraft. The conquest raised the Epic Besieger to Legendary renown as the Captor of Rhodes.

ptolemy.title: Ptolemy I Soter, Dynasty Founder
ptolemy.condition: Earn the government capstone and successfully found the Ptolemaic dynasty.
ptolemy.biography: After securing Egypt, Alexander's former general Ptolemy established an independent hereditary kingdom. Founding the Ptolemaic dynasty elevated the Epic statesman to Legendary renown.

zeno.title: Zeno, Stoic School Founder
zeno.condition: Earn the ethical-inquiry capstone and establish an independently functioning Stoic school. This remains the working Legendary criterion.
zeno.biography: Teaching virtue and reason at Athens' Painted Porch, Zeno established an independently functioning Stoic school. That sustained foundation elevated the Epic teacher to Legendary renown.
